title: 1 Million Collectibles Shipped: How Shipping Items on Courtyard Works & Why It Proves Physical Ownership
summary: From a $784k 1st Edition Charizard to Rolex grails, Courtyard has shipped 1M+ vaulted items. Learn how redemptions work and why physical backing matters.
body_markdown:
It’s official: Courtyard just shipped its 1 millionth collectible.


[Since 2021](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/courtyard-turns-5-biggest-pulls) , Courtyard has brought the fun and thrill of discovery back to shopping by allowing collectors to discover exciting, desirable items—from[Pokémon](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=pkmn) and[comic books](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=comics) to[luxury watches](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=watches) and[sneakers](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=sneakers) —all of which are[backed by physical vaulted inventory](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/is-courtyard-io-legit-heres-what-you-need-to-know) , bridging physical asset ownership with digital convenience. Open a digital pack, instantly own the physical item it represents, and then choose to keep it in your inventory, flip it via our instant buyback or on our marketplace (for 0% fees), or ship it to your home.


Now, five years later, we’re proud to say that we’ve provided collectors with more than 1 million reasons to keep the items they pull—proving that what you see on Courtyard is truly what you get.


### **TL;DR:**


- Collectors on Courtyard have shipped more than 1 million collectibles home.
- [Every item on Courtyard is authenticated and/or graded by a third party](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/welcome-to-card-school-the-difference-between-slabbed-cards-and-their-raw-counterparts) like PSA, BGS, or CGC before it enters the platform.
- Shipping the physical items from your digital collection is a simple, three-step process available for any item in your Courtyard collection.
- Every collectible on Courtyard is stored in our own dedicated vault and insured at full market value. Redeem it anytime and we'll ship it to your door.


Interested in having your Courtyard collection shipped to your home? Here’s how.


## **What Does It Mean to Redeem And Ship An Item on Courtyard**


Every collectible you pull from a[Courtyard pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine) or buy on[Courtyard’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace) sits stored in our dedicated vault, complete with security and insurance at no cost. If you want to remove an item from the vault, you can have the physical item shipped to your address.


Since 2021, we’ve had 1 million items shipped home, meaning collectors have chosen to pull a whopping 1 *million* items from their collections—all pulled from Courtyard packs or purchased on the Courtyard marketplace—and have them shipped home.


## **1 Million Items, A Dozen Categories of Collectibles**


What started as a platform for PSA-graded[Pokémon](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=pkmn) has since turned into a collectibles hub featuring[ancient Roman coins](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=coins) ,[Nike Dunks](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Nike%20Dunk) ,[Magic: The Gathering](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=magic_the_gathering) cards, and sports grails ranging from the[gridiron](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) to the[hardwood](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=basketball) .

## **Proof of Ownership: How Courtyard Ensures Vault Security, Grading, and Authenticity**


Until recently, collecting meant physically holding the items you owned. Today, it looks a little different.


Digital collecting requires trust.[Is this item on my screen legit](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/is-courtyard-io-legit-heres-what-you-need-to-know) *? Do I actually own it?* On Courtyard, the answer to both questions is an undeniable “YES,” and we prove it each and every day by shipping the items collectors pull and buy to their homes. But before those items arrive, Courtyard is working hard to prove the validity of the items in the vault to collectors.


- **Authentication:** Every item you see on Courtyard is either authenticated by a third party or graded by PSA, BGS or CGC before it goes into a pack. We don't grade or authenticate cards ourselves to ensure we remain impartial, and we don’t put anything into packs until it receives grading and/or authentication.
- **A public record:** Each item's ownership history is publicly recorded so you can see who held it, what they paid for it, and what they did with it, all on the item’s page.
- **A high security vault—with insurance:** Items on Courtyard are insured for free while stored with us in our dedicated vault.
- **1 million shipments:** Every redemption on Courtyard represents an item that was pulled or purchased by a collector and shipped to their home.


“1 million collectibles have now gone from Courtyard to fans’ front doors. A 1st Edition Holo Charizard, a Michael Jordan rookie card, a rare comic book from the ‘50s, a Rolex someone’s wanted for years. Every one is a fan getting closer to something they love, and that’s the whole point of Courtyard,” **said Courtyard Co-Founder and CEO Nicolas Le Jeune.**


## **How to Redeem an Item From Your Courtyard Collection and Ship it to Your Front Door:**


Shipping an item on Courtyard means removing a physical collectible from Courtyard's dedicated vault and having it shipped directly to your door. Here’s how it works in three easy steps:


1. **Step 1: Select your item and tap redeem -** Open any collectible in your Courtyard collection and tap “Redeem.”
2. **Step 2: Verify your ID -** In order to comply with regulations, we require users to provide us with their ID information to maintain the security of Courtyard's platform for all users. **‍**
3. **Step 3: Confirm Shipping and taxes** – **** Enter your address, select and pay for your preferred carrier shipping method, and pay local sales tax based on your shipping address.


Every pull presents collectors with the option to keep, flip, or ship their new collectible, but Courtyard is helping make one choice even easier for collectors. Now, Courtyard is slashing shipping costs to help collectors get their cards faster, for less.


You can view the full rules around redemptions and shipping in[our Help Center article](https://docs.courtyard.io/courtyard/logistics-and-legal/asset-redemption-and-shipping) .


## **Thank You, Collectors**


1 million redemptions were made possible by you, the collectors, one pack and marketplace purchase at a time. Thank you to everyone who opened packs, traded items, listed collectibles, and shipped with us, and to the collectors who held their first-ever graded card in their hands because of Courtyard.


Ready to start your next stack?[Open a pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine) , check card values with[Courtyard’s Price Guide](https://courtyard.io/prices) , or[browse the marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace) for a steal of a deal.


Here's to millions more!


## **FAQ**


**Do I have to redeem the items I pull?**


No. Items can stay in Courtyard’s dedicated vault for as long as collectors want, with free storage and insurance.


**What does it cost to redeem and ship an item on Courtyard?** ‍


There is no extra cost to redeem an item. However, collectors pay for shipping charges, which are dependent on the shipping method they select, plus sales tax based on their address. Recently, Courtyard lowered the cost of shipping charges across various shipping methods, helping collectors get their items faster, for less.


**How long does the redemption and shipping process take?** ‍


Redemptions are processed in as little as 24 hours. From there, shipping times depend on the shipping method chosen by each collector, with options like FedEx Ground Economy typically taking 2-7 business days to arrive at a collector's residence.


**How can I verify the provenance of an item before redeeming it?**


Every item on Courtyard is visible via a transparent, public record that can be viewed by any collector on Courtyard. This ledger includes everything from ownership history to the price paid for the item and previous owners.
